10k.note: Ligand operates as a biopharmaceutical royalty aggregator with two infrastructure-light platform technologies (Captisol, NITRICIL). Per the 2025 10-K, Ligand does not directly sponsor any active clinical-stage drug development programs; clinical execution is done by partners who hold the IND/NDA.

website.note: Corporate site presents royalty/portfolio-aggregator business model. No internal pipeline page; pipeline.aspx and portfolio pages return 404.

ctgov.note: All Ligand-sponsored trials returned by clinicaltrials.gov are COMPLETED or TERMINATED legacy programs (Targretin/bexarotene, lasofoxifene, LGD-6972, MB07803, PS433540). No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 trials.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Ligand Pharmaceuticals is a royalty aggregator and capital partner, not an operating drug developer. Per its 2025 10-K, its strategy (refocused in 2022) is to acquire royalty interests in third-party-owned mid- to late-stage assets and to operate two royalty-generating platform technologies (Captisol, NITRICIL). Clinical development is sponsored and executed by its partners (e.g., Travere, Merck, Roche, Castle Creek), and these assets belong to those partners, not to Ligand. Ligand itself sponsors no active P1/P2/P3 trials.
excluded_partner_owned: D-Fi / FCX-007 (Castle Creek) Phase 3 DEB — royalty only
